name: Sound separation
what: Split music into four parts and clean background noise from speech. Stays on this Mac. Requires macOS 26.

args:
import pathlib,platform,sys,venv,shutil
if sys.version_info[:2] != (3,12) or platform.machine() != 'arm64' or int(platform.mac_ver()[0].split('.')[0]) < 26:
 raise SystemExit('Sound separation needs Apple silicon, macOS 26 and the precut Python 3.12 runtime.')
base=pathlib.Path.cwd()
venv.create(base/'venv',with_pip=True)
(base/'models').mkdir()
for name in ['htdemucs.safetensors','htdemucs_config.json']:
 shutil.copyfile(base/'downloads'/name,base/'models'/name)
shutil.copyfile(base/'downloads/deep-filter',base/'deep-filter')
(base/'deep-filter').chmod(0o755)
